bugs: User patch/delete resolve by (id, user_id) with NO is_deleted filter in the lookup itself (views/asset.py:210,237,366,394: get(id, user_id)); operating on an already-soft-deleted row re-saves it without clearing is_deleted (delete is idempotent 204; patch flips is_uploaded on a deleted row). Port as-is.

Generic post converts size with int(request.data.get('size', FILE_SIZE_LIMIT)) BEFORE the required check (views/asset.py:505 vs :511): explicit size=null -> int(None) TypeError -> 500 via handle_exception else-branch, not the 400 below. Port as-is.

entity_asset_delete_lookups.rule: USER_AVATAR -> User.objects.get(id=asset.user_id); user.avatar_asset_id=None; user.save() (full save). USER_COVER -> same with cover_image_asset_id. Anything else -> return None (profile untouched). Duplicated verbatim in UserAssetEndpoint (views/asset.py:60-73) and UserServerAssetEndpoint (:258-271).
sql: SELECT <users cols> FROM "users" WHERE ("users"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "users"."id" = %s);  -- User.objects.get(id=asset.user_id), soft-delete manager applies
UPDATE "users" SET ... WHERE "users"."id" = %s;  -- user.save(), full-field save

external_dedupe.rule: Only when external_id AND external_source both truthy. .first() -> None when absent (proceed to create).
external_dedupe.sql: SELECT <file_assets cols> FROM "file_assets" WHERE ("file_assets"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "file_assets"."workspace_id" IN (SELECT ... WHERE "workspaces"."slug" = %s) AND "file_assets"."external_source" = %s AND "file_assets"."external_id" = %s AND "file_assets"."is_deleted" = false) ORDER BY "file_assets"."created_at" DESC LIMIT 1;

result_rows.missing: FileAsset.DoesNotExist -> 404 {'error': 'Asset not found'} (generic get/patch own the body; views/asset.py:459-460,620-621)

generic_detail_lookup.rule: FileAsset.objects.get(id=asset_id, workspace__slug=slug, is_deleted=False). is_uploaded guard lives in the handler (fx-h-asset-generic), not here.
generic_detail_lookup.sql: SELECT <file_assets cols> FROM "file_assets" INNER JOIN "workspaces" ON ("file_assets"."workspace_id" = "workspaces"."id") WHERE ("file_assets"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "file_assets"."id" = %s AND "workspaces"."slug" = %s AND "file_assets"."is_deleted" = false);

soft_delete_helper.rule: FileAsset.objects.filter(id=asset_id).first(); None -> return None (silent no-op, stays 204 on the wire via callers that ignore the return). Else is_deleted=True, deleted_at=now, save(update_fields=['is_deleted','deleted_at']). NOTE: no is_deleted=False filter, so it re-deletes deleted rows (deleted_at bumped).
sql: SELECT <file_assets cols> FROM "file_assets" WHERE ("file_assets"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "file_assets"."id" = %s) ORDER BY "file_assets"."created_at" DESC LIMIT 1;  -- .first(), soft-delete manager applies, no is_deleted filter

result_rows.found: one row (is_deleted may be true; callers do not filter it)
result_rows.missing: FileAsset.DoesNotExist -> BaseAPIView.handle_exception maps ObjectDoesNotExist -> 404 {'error': 'The requested resource does not exist.'} (views/base.py:154-159)

user_scoped_get.rule: FileAsset.objects.get(id=asset_id, user_id=request.user.id). Soft-delete manager adds deleted_at IS NULL; there is deliberately no is_deleted=False predicate.
user_scoped_get.sql: SELECT <file_assets cols> FROM "file_assets" WHERE ("file_assets"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "file_assets"."id" = %s AND "file_assets"."user_id" = %s);
